name: Lunar gravity kernel and reference trajectories
purpose: Verify the production lunar point-mass acceleration before trajectory testing.
configuration: Isolated production lunar-gravity kernel at r=2 lunar radii; valid for both orbit-off and orbit-on builds.
procedure: Link the probe to libAMPS.a, invoke the compiled lunar point-mass kernel used by TotalParticleAcceleration, and compare all acceleration components.
acceptance_criteria: Radial component within 1e-14 relative; transverse components exactly zero.
expected_pass_result: Production acceleration equals the analytical lunar two-body value.
status_semantics: PASS verifies the local kernel only; linked mover trajectories require I05.
